title: HANKO Handelmaatschappij B.V.
content:
HANKO is a Dutch insulation distributor with deep stock of technical insulation materials for industrial customers. It is one of the more established European channels for Aspen Aerogels blanket products and supports fast delivery across multiple countries.

  • Coverage Area: Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, and broader Europe
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, high-temperature insulation, cryogenic insulation, corrosion-under-insulation mitigation, and just-in-time aerogel supply
  • Current Brands Represented: Aspen Aerogels (Pyrogel®, Cryogel®)
  • Official Website: https://www.hanko.nl/en/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
